name: inspect_host_shell
description: Inspect shell defaults and discover commands across activities, including work whose initial call is still waiting. Command handles remain usable until retirement or restart; full logs persist independently.

command_id.description: Select one command; omit to list current commands.

offset.description: Position in the matching command list. Use the reply's next_offset to continue; null marks the end.

name: run_host_shell
description: Run a command in a fresh shell. Return its outcome, or command_id and callback_id when it continues beyond the wait. A returned callback_id confirms one completion observation for this focus. Full output remains in logs.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the startup directory when not absolute; omission uses that directory.

mode.description: batch closes stdin; pipe accepts input; terminal merges stdout/stderr and applies terminal processing.

timeout_ms.description: Stop the command after this duration; omission leaves it without a deadline.

max_output_bytes.description: Budget shared by stdout and stderr after JSON encoding; metadata and native media are additional.

interpretation.description: Treat complete stdout text of up to 16 KiB as an image URL. Image bytes are recognized automatically.

yield_ms.description: Wait for completion before returning control; zero returns immediately. This wait does not limit command duration.

name: continue_host_shell
description: Read more output or interact with a command. Reads advance shared stdout/stderr positions across activities, independently of initial previews and completion observations. Completion still goes to the focus that started the command. Draining a finished command retires its handle.

eof.description: Close pipe stdin after this text, or send Ctrl-D to a terminal without closing its input.

write.description: Only one write can be pending; stdin.pending and stdin.error report delivery.

name.description: Interrupt reaches the terminal foreground group; terminate and kill reach its original session. Without a terminal, signals reach the command's process group.

action.description: Apply input or control before observing output, even while another call waits.

yield_ms.description: Wait for unread output or completion; zero returns the current state.

max_output_bytes.description: Budget shared by stdout and stderr after JSON encoding; metadata and native media are additional.
